designRecommendation.problem: At320px, the editorial headline, subtitle and progress stamp precede the primary next task even when review work is waiting.
designRecommendation.recommendation: Keep the brand typography, but use a compact mobile intro when queued work exists. Put the next task, its honest count and primary CTA directly after the route title, before the progress stamp/history. Keep calm introductory framing for genuine no-work and scan-in-progress states.

evidence.detail: Actual waiting/first-review work selects compact mobile hierarchy.
Cleanup stamp follows the primary review/task section in reading order.
At480px and below, preserves brand heading with smaller size and less spacing.
Four cases preserve Triage/Screener task-before-history order, calm no-work state and honest sync state.

designRecommendation.implementation: Implemented compact mobile Home intro when review work awaits; real task/CTA precedes recorded-progress stamp in reading order. Genuine no-work and syncing states retain calm framing; brand typography and desktop stamp position remain.
designRecommendation.summary: When a real review task awaits, mobile Home compresses the brand intro and puts the next task/CTA before the cleanup stamp in DOM reading order. Quiet and scan-in-progress states retain calm framing; desktop stamp position is preserved.
tests: home-view.test.tsx: 4 new hierarchy cases passed in first integration run.
